adjudication.rationale: In `Discourse.Group#findMembers`, the request `offset` is clamped using the client’s current `user_count` (`var self = this, offset = Math.min(this.get("user_count"), Math.max(this.get("offset"), 0));`). After `removeMember`, the model immediately calls `self.findMembers()` without adjusting `offset` first. If you remove the only user on the last page, the client still has the pre-removal `user_count` and keeps the same `offset`, so it can re-request an offset that is now beyond the new total and receive an empty `members` array, leaving the admin on an effectively invalid/empty page. This behavior is directly implied by the diff’s new pagination + reload logic.
